High-margin content generation; parses global logistics and geographical trends
Virtual engine environments; creates high-fidelity simulation environments to model system logic and AI agent frameworks
Automated storytelling media; scalable, passive digital revenue; establishes positive foundational programming for future generations
IP foundry & patent development; synthesizes technological frameworks and manages the core intellectual property catalog
Industrial mineral reclamation; secures supply-chain independence by reclaiming rare metals to back the token treasury
Cold fission bio-hardware; the pinnacle breakthrough; shifts human hardware dependency away from fossil and grid infrastructure

summary.notes: Seven sectors mapped from blueprint exactly. Role distribution is non-uniform: travel, kids, innovation, and quantum use 3 ops agents; shoes, gamedev, and e-waste use 2 ops agents. Auxiliary layer supports CEO, finance, security, global operations, and vagary-index delivery.
